text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeating the "Emperor" Symboli Rudolf, 
Sirius Symboli splendidly ascends to the 
throne.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later— a press conference 
was finally held to announce their 
two-year overseas expedition plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli told them to simply follow 
behind her, the brightest star, as she 
carved out a precedent and became a beacon 
for those who follow.
